verdict.rationale: EDD's open enrollment guidance page documents some of the credential steps before you start: an email verification link to complete enrollment and setting up an additional login verification method by text or phone. Its file-and-pay page also states upfront that payroll tax payments need no enrollment. However, the evidence shows no consolidated, up-front list of every account, credential, and identity-proofing step required before filing, and the transactional portal itself could not be inspected. Missing for 10: a complete published prerequisite checklist for filing, documentation of identity-proofing requirements beyond email and MFA, the account/registration prerequisites stated as a pre-flight list, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no steps surface mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Select the verification link in the email we sent you to complete the enrollment process.
Select Text Message or Phone Call to set up an additional login verification method or select use my email instead.
Make a payroll tax payment. No enrollment is necessary to use this service.
